title: Threshold (com.qlabs.threshold)
description: Runs app updates behind a blurred progress screen at the first login after each boot.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Kill switch. Set to false and Threshold does nothing.

capSeconds.title: Blur cap (seconds)
capSeconds.description: The blur lifts after this long. A running install is never killed; it continues in the background. 30 to 3600.

maxConsecutiveFailures.title: Failures before quarantine
maxConsecutiveFailures.description: An item that fails this many times in a row for the same target version is skipped until its target version changes. Minimum 1.

minBatteryPercent.title: Minimum battery (%)
minBatteryPercent.description: On battery power, items are skipped below this charge. 0 to 100.

requireAC.title: Require AC power
requireAC.description: Skip installs unless the Mac is plugged in.

minFreeDiskGB.title: Minimum free disk (GB)
minFreeDiskGB.description: Skip installs when free disk space is below this.

ignoredUsers.title: Ignored users
ignoredUsers.description: Short names of accounts that never trigger Threshold.

networkWaitSeconds.title: Network wait for Jamf items (seconds)
networkWaitSeconds.description: If the Jamf Pro server is unreachable at login (Wi-Fi often joins after login), wait up to this long under the blur before skipping Jamf-trigger items. 0 = don't wait (and show no blur if only Jamf items are due).

message.title: Dialog message
message.default: Installing important updates. This usually takes a few minutes.

icon.title: Dialog icon
icon.description: Path or URL of an icon. Empty uses the default.

windowStyle.title: Window style
windowStyle.description: Modern: app cards with a progress bar (needs swiftDialog 3.0.1 or later; older swiftDialog automatically uses Classic). Classic: a simple list. Both follow the user's light or dark mode.

blurScreen.title: Blur the screen
blurScreen.description: On (default): the desktop is blurred and blocked while updates install. Off: the progress window shows over a usable desktop, for testing or gentler rollouts; users can then work, or restart, during installs.

statusLog.title: Status log
statusLog.description: Optional. Full path of a log file, e.g. /var/log/install.log. While an app waits or installs, the newest line of this log is shown under it. Users see that text, so pick a log that's fine to show. Empty: the usual Installing / Done text.

supportText.title: Support text
supportText.description: Shown when something fails (Classic window only).
supportText.default: If this keeps happening, contact IT.

items.title: Items
items.description: Updates to run, top to bottom. For each item, first choose Jamf policy or Cached package.

id.title: ID
id.description: Stable identifier. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' only. Must be unique.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Shown in the dialog. Defaults to the ID.

appPath.title: App path
appPath.description: Full path of the app, e.g. /Applications/Google Chrome.app. No quotes. Use this or Version command, not both.

versionCommand.title: Version command
versionCommand.description: Command that prints the installed version. Use this or appPath, not both.

versionKey.title: Version key
versionKey.description: Info.plist key to read when appPath is used.

targetVersion.title: Target version
targetVersion.description: Minimum acceptable version. Anything older is updated.

installIfMissing.title: Install if missing
installIfMissing.description: On: if the app isn't on the Mac yet (new builds), install it. Off (default): Threshold only updates apps that are already installed and skips missing ones.

source.title: Source
source.description: Set by your choice above. Leave as is.

trigger.title: Jamf trigger
trigger.description: Custom event name of the Jamf policy that installs the update. No spaces.

preInstallScript.title: Pre-install script
preInstallScript.description: Absolute path. Must be root-owned and not group/other-writable, including parent directories.

postInstallScript.title: Post-install script
postInstallScript.description: Absolute path. Same ownership rules as the pre-install script.

healthProcess.title: Health: process name
healthProcess.description: Setting any health key turns the post-install health check on.

healthCommand.title: Health: command
healthCommand.description: Passes when it exits 0. Setting any health key turns the post-install health check on.

healthURL.title: Health: URL
healthURL.description: http(s) URL that must be reachable. Setting any health key turns the post-install health check on.

teamID.title: Signing Team ID
teamID.description: 10-character Apple Team ID the package is signed by. Get it with: pkgutil --check-signature App.pkg

fallbackTrigger.description: Jamf custom event to run instead if the cached package is missing or doesn't match. No spaces.
